measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w2

measurements.name: smem_conflict_ratio_w4

measurements.name: l1_latency_ns

measurements.name: l2_latency_ns

measurements.name: dram_latency_ns

measurements.name: dram_gbps

measurements.name: l2_knee_bytes
measurements.method: largest working set of the sweep still within 95% of the plateau bandwidth

measurements.name: atomic_uncontended_ns
measurements.method: one CTA, dependent chain of 2048 global atomicAdd; the return value feeds the next address so this is latency, not issue rate

measurements.name: atomic_contention_ns
measurements.method: N CTAs hammering one address; the recorded value is inverse throughput (elapsed / N / iters), which is what T_sync = |image(C_kappa)| * latency multiplies

measurements.name: threadfence_ns

measurements.name: syncthreads_ns

measurements.name: named_barrier_ns

measurements.name: grid_barrier_ns

measurements.name: interference_neighbour_gbps
measurements.method: read-modify-write over 256 MiB at one CTA per SM, four passes; the neighbour interference_ratio is measured against

measurements.name: interference_ratio
measurements.method: median of paired ratios; each pair is the duration of a 32x64x32s3 BF16 Tensor Core GEMM (M=4, N=1536, K=2048, split 16) on its own stream while a 256 MiB streaming read-modify-write runs at one CTA per SM on another stream

measurements.name: dram_peak_gbps
measurements.method: 2 * memory clock * bus width from cudaDeviceGetAttribute; the pin rate, not an achieved one

measurements.name: dram_fraction_of_peak
measurements.method: achieved dram_gbps over the pin rate; the run is rejected below kMinFractionOfPeak

measurements.name: dram_drift
measurements.method: largest working set re-measured after every other group, against its value from the sweep; the run is rejected above kMaxDrift
